note: City campground in 370 Lakeside Park, a 500-acre park on a 140-acre lake with a lake trail, about 30 minutes west of St. Louis. --Claude
summary: Rates confirmed $50 gravel / $57 paved (ResNexus $57 paved 2027-05-12); electricity metered extra at $0.14/kWh, 3% card fee; 6 people included, $2 each extra. 75 sites incl. pull-throughs; reservable on ResNexus; open all year. Lakeview confirmed (loop ends ~20-35 m from the lake behind the loop road and lake trail).
flags: PRICE GATE (local park; flag only): the base is exactly $50 (gravel) and electricity is billed on top by meter at $0.14/kWh after check-out, plus 3% on card payments. gateways.py: St. Louis metro 39 km, inside the 40-km exception. Cheapest bookable on ResNexus for 2027-05-12 was paved at $57 (no gravel site showed for that date).

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview): confirmed. The lake surface (DEM 127 m) is level with the campground (128 m), no berm. The four loops' north ends sit ~20-35 m from the shore across open grass, but the loop road's curve and the paved lake trail run between the pads and the water, so lakeview, not lakefront.
Hookups: no page read states amperage (the city's Smart Metering brochure and fees PDF are behind Cloudflare); the stored electric 50 and the old note's '20/30/50 amp' are left as stored (derived).
Facilities (showers, laundry, camp store, Wi-Fi) rest on the old note; the welcome packet (flippingbook) was not read. Left as stored.

LONG-STAY: winter monthly rates (Nov-Mar) and weekly rates are offered, with a 60-day cap Apr-Oct; nightly reservation is the main channel and 25 paved sites showed open for a May weekday. Doesn't read as long-stay in character.
Pin 38.82060,-90.57700 sits in the second loop - fine.
